.²1 An elephantʼs eye-ball. Edgerton, the author of <ls>Mātaṅga L.</ls>, however,
 says that this meaning is wrong and points out that it means, ‘The under
 surface of the top of the eye-socket of an elephant. {#IzikA tvakzikUwakam#}’
 <ls>Mātaṅga L. 6. 9</ls>.
.²2 A painterʼs brush.
.²3 A weapon, arrow, dart.
